data.one_liner: HTML rich text editor for Android, iOS, and Web using the Summernote library
data.what_it_does: Provides a WYSIWYG HTML text editor widget supporting Android, iOS, and Web via a WebView and the Summernote library. Includes customizable widget-based controls, callbacks, dark mode, and file pickers.
use_when: You need a WYSIWYG HTML editor inside your Flutter mobile or web application
You want support for dark mode, custom toolbars, and rich text callbacks
avoid_when: You only need a standard plain text input field
You want a fully native text rendering engine without using a WebView or web libraries
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Flutter Web
Controller-based API for ease of use
Includes features like dark mode, file insertion, and spellcheck
weaknesses: Can experience flickering on Flutter Web depending on the web renderer
Relies on a WebView wrapper around Summernote rather than purely native text widgets
data.setup_notes: Requires adding internet permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and setting up file picker configurations for iOS if media picking is enabled.
